name: EOD 2026-09-19
body:
> Eod · Pipeliners · 2026-09-19

Saturday. Pipeliners only (Sep 18 to 19): low-hanging fruit keyword tracker, plan and fixes.

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Tracker: GSC Aug 20 to Sep 16, checked day by day; 173 real keywords in positions 8 to 30, all on city pages, no blog posts.
- Plan: fix internal links, fix wrong-city image descriptions, Wave 1 (Avondale, Glendale, Paradise Valley) and Wave 2 (San Tan Valley, Coolidge, Laveen, Casa Grande) keyword alignment, real job photos (waiting on Scott), one supporting blog, hold Tolleson and Peoria until repiping is confirmed, review Oct 17.
- Done: Services page now links to 6 more cities and "nofollow" removed from all 16 existing city links.
- Fixed 169 wrong city names in image descriptions across 74 pages (pipe photos said "Anthem").
- 7 city pages now carry the keyword in title, H1, meta, opening, a subheading and schema ("Trenchless Sewer Repair in [City], AZ" or "Sewer Line Repair in [City], AZ"). Fixed an OTTO "Pipe Lining" subheading on Laveen.
- Published supporting blog /clay-sewer-pipe/ linking to 4 city pages and 6 related posts; indexing requested. Removed unverified pipe lifespan numbers from a linking post.
- Blog merges: 9 old posts now 301 to stronger posts (2 on Sep 18, 7 on Sep 19), old posts kept as drafts. Indexing requested for the 5 stronger posts.
- New artifacts: blog keyword positions tracker, page 2 blog keyword plan, a how-to PDF, website pages tracker update.

# Follow-ups
- Kim: decide the last 2 merges (#4 and #11) and city links on the Service Areas page.
- Scott: real job photos; does Pipeliners do repiping.
- Checks: Sep 20 images, Sep 30 Buckeye, Oct 9 pages changed Sep 16, Oct 17 results for the 7 city pages, clay pipe blog and merged posts.
